nodes.label: Ingest capability context
nodes.rationale: Ingest converts local Old English .txt and TEI/XML into caller-provided JSON. LLM-assisted ingest, HTML/PDF/unstructured, and HTTP fetch are out of this repo (ADR 0010) and live in wordwending, so source convert must not fetch URLs or call a model. Shared behavior belongs in DocumentIngestor.ingest rather than in one caller.

nodes.label: DocumentIngestor
nodes.rationale: DocumentIngestor.ingest is the root pipeline decision point. Shared ingest behavior should usually be fixed there rather than in one CLI caller. source convert is CLI-first and always takes an explicit output path.

nodes.label: wordwending
nodes.rationale: ML and messy-document ingest live in wordwending. This repo does not take on LLM-assisted ingest, HTML/PDF/unstructured, or HTTP fetch.

nodes.label: ADR 0010
nodes.rationale: ADR 0010 keeps LLM-assisted ingest and related messy-document paths out of this repo. Settings likewise excludes LLM and OCR settings under ADR 0010 and ADR 0007.
